text: The system development life cycle is the sequence of phases every system passes through, each producing a deliverable for the next. Preliminary investigation defines the problem. A feasibility study asks whether it is technically, economically, operationally and legally possible. Analysis gathers the requirements. Design decides how. Then coding, testing, implementation with training, and maintenance, which feeds back into the cycle.
